name: Command bridge droid
description: The command bridge droid, also known simply as the command droid, were modified TDA-series droid assistant, a model of protocol droid used to crew the command bridge of the Colossus, a supertanker fuel depot. 4D-M1N, Captain Imanuel Doza's liaison, was a command bridge droid, and the Colossus more basic and pared down command droids answered to her.
